items.why: Slipped below $84,000 after Iranian attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz sent Brent above $101, lifted Treasury yields and the dollar, and forced about $547 million in liquidations.
Falling with the broader tech pullback as Treasury yields hit a 24-year high; separate headlines flagged $16 billion in fraud-linked revenue and deepfake scam ads on Facebook.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.
Up while Amazon's Prime Big Deal Days sale runs Oct 6-7, with new deals dropping three times a day across electronics, home goods and holiday gifts.

market_note: Futures are soft across the board; crypto is getting hit harder on oil-driven risk-off flows.
summary: Stocks are pulling back from records as Treasury yields hit a 24-year high and geopolitical risk flares, with the Dow down about 500 points and the Nasdaq retreating.
